_README: Necromancer pass #3 (2026-09-10). First autopsy of Hephaestus (no AGENT_AUTOPSIES.jsonl record exists). Archaeology only: the forge (LLM APIs) was NOT run; its loaders were run as instruments after an apparatus control (LAW N14). Opened because the Coeus pass handed two questions about the forge ledger it depends on. Evidence scripts + result JSONs under dossiers/hephaestus_evidence/ (README there). Verdict rests on THREE independent instruments that all carried their own answer, and on what the population looks like once the payload is removed.

original_organism.premise: An LLM, prompted with a combination of 2-3 scientific concepts (from Nous), will write a Python reasoning tool; a falsification battery (traps with known answers, pass = beat an NCD baseline on accuracy or calibration without losing on either) will filter the output so that the surviving 'forged' tools form a library of genuine reasoning mechanisms that downstream agents (Apollo genes, Nemesis, Hermes, Coeus) can consume.
original_organism.mechanism: Daemon loop: load Nous combos -> sort by _forge_priority -> for each combo not in the ledger, call the LLM (per-item retry with 2**attempt backoff only on api_call_failed), validate/sandbox the code, run run_trap_battery against _ncd_baseline, and append ONE ledger row with status in {forged, scrap} plus a reason string. Forged tools written to forge/<key>.py + .json.
producers: Coeus (proposed priority scorer; never wired, see coeus.dossier.json)
inputs: LLM completions (qwen/qwen3.5-397b-a17b recorded on 1352 rows; model absent on 5309 rows; 4-model fallback from 05-26)
battery: 15 static TRAPS (until 2026-03-27), then trap_generator_extended (186 traps / 89 categories, seed 42), then tier-stratified (05-18) and behavioural-NCD (05-26) variants
outputs: forge/*.py tools (366 on disk; the 06-24 dossier cites ~1,960 historically, ~385 forged rows in the ledger)
intended_consumers: Apollo v1 (gene_extractor.py reads the forge dir as a gene pool)

observed_history.run_period: 2026-03-2x .. 2026-05-28 (last ledger rows); six code eras cut at hephaestus.py commit timestamps: W0 pre-v2, W1 15-trap (03-25..03-27), W2 58-category (03-27..05-17), W3 revival (05-17..05-18), W4 tier-stratified (05-18..05-26), W5 behavioural-NCD (>=05-26)
measurements: Ledger yield per era, INSTRUMENT rows (api_call_failed / wall_clock_timeout / test_harness_error) separated from generation defects and battery failures (heph_ledger_shape_result.json): W0 269 rows/116 forged (yield excl. instrument 0.48); W1 1313/237 (0.229; among battery-tested 0.264); W2 3753/10 (0.0083; among battery-tested 0.0128; 2553 instrument rows); W3 116/5 (0.043); W4 861/15 (0.018); W5 349/2 (0.0057).
353 of ~385 forged rows are pre-03-27 (15-trap era). Their mean accuracy is 0.304 (mode 0.27), calibration 0.271 -- BELOW the 15-trap chance floor of 0.417 accuracy / 0.5 calibration.

Gate replica on the 15-trap battery (heph_battery_floor_result.json): NCD baseline scores 0.267 acc / 0.133 cal (below chance on both); a uniformly random tool passes the pass gate 92.75% of 2000 draws; a constant-first-candidate tool scores 0.133/0.0.

Gate replica on the 186-trap extended battery: chance floor 0.324; NCD baseline 0.393/0.452 (above chance -> discriminative); random tool passes 2.4%. Observed forge yield among battery-tested tools in the honest eras: 1.28% (W2), 6.8% (W3, n=74), 2.24% (W4), 0.72% (W5) -- at or below the random pass rate.

Positive control that the honest battery is beatable: hand-written composer.py engines (commit 6348c1014, 2026-05-30) score R1 0.50 / R3 0.39 / R4 0.61 on the same 186-probe battery, far above the 0.324 floor.

Nemesis consumer (heph_nemesis_consumer_result.json): 92 adversarial prompts x 140 forged tools; population median accuracy 0.386 vs per-prompt chance floor 0.370; median 91.5 of 138.5 tools crash per prompt; correct answer is first-or-last in 87/92 prompts (a first-or-last picker ceilings at 0.946); the eight highest-scoring tools (0.64-0.77) answer index 0/last and score 0.0 on 7 of 8 tools over the 5 middle-position prompts (floor 0.267).

Independent re-measurement (Aporia PROF-FORGE-COHORT, 2026-08-20, 48 tools, 20-probe battery): v1 median 0.10 vs chance 0.25 (adapter leak: distractors derived from truth+3i); v2 exchangeable distractors -> median 0.25 = chance; verdict TOOLS-FLAT-AT-CHANCE, the earlier TOOLS-DISCRIMINATE reading retracted.
Instrument burial (Q1): 2861 ledger keys were first recorded as scrap/api_call_failed; 0 of them were ever retried (load_ledger keys form the daemon's global skip set).
Duplicate keys: 10 (last-wins on load). frame field absent on 1967 rows, model absent on 5309 rows.
actual_consumers: Apollo v1 (apollo/archive/v1/src/gene_extractor.py reads F:/Prometheus/agents/hephaestus/forge/ as genes) -- archived; 2026-05-22 baseline-matrix falsification found 0/5 elites beat the best single primitive
Apollo v2 -- SEVERED the library (CYCLE 156-S, 2026-08-24): v1's ISA and forge_primitives were the same 25 hand-written functions; the LLM-forged tools were not what carried
Nemesis adversarial battery (92 prompts, 140 tools) -- consumed as probe targets, result at chance
Aporia PROF-FORGE-COHORT (48 tools) -- consumed as a QC cohort, result flat at chance
Coeus -- consumed the ledger as labels (see coeus.dossier.json: learned the forge calendar, not concepts)
composer.py failure mining -- consumed 860 near-miss SCRAPS to design hand-written engines (+11pp R3, +32pp R4); the ledger's failures, not its forged tools, were the productive output
consumption_evidence: git log 6348c1014 (composer engines designed from failure mining of 6,657 ledger entries)

prior_verdicts: pivot/COMPONENT_DOSSIERS_2026-06-24.md (### Hephaestus): advisory REVIVE, state LIMBO; 'naive thesis (LLM-generated reasoning tools at scale) was falsified by its own instrumentation: ~1,960 tools were ~5 genuine mechanisms'; block = M3 dead + Nous gate (cited, not trusted; LAW N11)
No AGENT_AUTOPSIES.jsonl record (first autopsy is this dossier)
autopsy.kill_boundary: What died is the PREMISE as instantiated: LLM-written tools from this prompt/model/battery pipeline do not reason above chance, and the forge never had an instrument that could have told it otherwise until 2026-03-27. Boundary, layer by layer: (1) CERTIFICATION LAYER, 2026-03-2x..03-27: the pass gate compared tools to an NCD baseline that scores BELOW chance on the 15 static traps, so a random tool passes 92.75% of the time; 353 of ~385 'forged' certificates are vacuous, and the forged tools themselves average 0.304 accuracy against a 0.417 chance floor. This is the layer the 06-24 dossier's '~1,960 tools' figure lives in. (2) HONEST-INSTRUMENT LAYER, 03-27 onward: with 186 traps the NCD baseline is above chance and a random tool passes 2.4%; the forge's yield among battery-tested tools falls to 0.7-2.2% -- indistinguishable from random passes -- across 1,803 battery-tested tools in W2-W5, while hand-written engines on the same battery reach 0.39-0.61. The premise was therefore tested at power and failed. (3) INSTRUMENT-STATE LAYER (Q1): api_call_failed is written as a scrap OUTCOME because forge_one returns {'status':'scrap','reason':'api_call_failed'} after per-item retries and the caller writes every non-forged result as scrap; the daemon's skip set is set(ledger.keys()), so 2,861 combos were buried on first API failure and 0 were ever retried. This is an ORCHESTRATION defect on top of the corpse, not its cause: removing instrument rows changes yield by <1pp in every honest era. (4) CONSUMER LAYER: Nemesis (140 tools) and Aporia (48 tools) independently measured the population at chance; Apollo v1's use of forged tools as genes did not beat single primitives; Apollo v2 severed the library; the one consumer that extracted value used the ledger's FAILURES to hand-design engines. What is NOT killed: the battery generator (discriminative from 03-27), the ledger as a failure-mining dataset, the hand-written composer engines and forge_primitives, and the general question of whether a different model/prompt could forge above chance (untested here; see uncertainty).
surviving_claims: The extended battery (trap_generator_extended, 186 traps / 89 categories) is a discriminative instrument: NCD baseline 0.39 > floor 0.32, random passes 2.4%, and hand-written engines reach 0.39-0.61 on it. It is beatable by real mechanisms and rarely passed by noise.

Failure mining of the ledger produced real, measured gains (composer engines +11pp R3 / +32pp R4 on the honest battery) -- the ledger's scraps carried direction even though its forged tools carried none.

Battery version IS recoverable per ledger row (Q2): accuracy/calibration denominators infer n_traps (15 for every pre-03-27 forged row; 186/93/62/31 afterwards) and agree with the hephaestus.py commit-time windows; the frame field (present on 4694 rows) and model field (1352 rows) mark sub-eras. Priority is NOT recoverable: append_ledger never carried it.
The daemon mechanics (item-level retry, sandboxing, ledger append, forge dir writing) worked as designed; the code did what it said.
uncertainty: Scope of the kill is the pipeline as instantiated (qwen3.5-397b and 2026-03..05 fallbacks, this prompt, this battery). Whether a stronger model or a different prompt would forge above chance is not measured here; the honest eras had at most ~1,803 battery-tested attempts, mostly under one model family.
W3 (revival, 05-17..05-18) shows 6.8% among battery-tested (5/74), above the 2.4% random rate; n is too small to read and the 5 forged tools were not independently re-measured.

The 06-24 dossier's '~5 genuine mechanisms' was not re-derived; this pass finds no forged tool that survives a payload-free measurement, but did not test every forged tool individually against a payload-free battery (Aporia tested 48, Nemesis 140 with a position payload).

The forge dir on disk (366) is smaller than the ledger's forged count (385) and far smaller than the '~1,960' cited on 06-24; the missing tools may sit on F:/ (Apollo v1 read F:/Prometheus/agents/hephaestus/forge/) and were not inventoried.
contradictory_evidence: Nemesis top tools reach 0.64-0.77 accuracy -- but this is at or under the 0.946 first-or-last picker ceiling and those tools score 0.0 on middle-position prompts, so it is a payload reading, not skill.
Aporia PROF v1 read TOOLS-DISCRIMINATE -- retracted by Aporia itself once the adapter leak was removed (v2).

frontiers: model coding capability (forge ran on qwen3.5-397b-a17b-era models, 2026-03..05)
model reliability (2,861 combos buried on first api_call_failed)
capability_contingency.era_bound_claim: 2026-03-era model + this forge prompt + this battery + this gate could not produce tools above the 2.4% random-pass floor (0.7-2.2% across 1,803 battery-tested tools).
capability_contingency.what_would_move_it: A frontier coding model behind a position-balanced honest gate with the scrap ledger as failure-mined direction; the dossier itself marks this 'untested here'. This is the archetypal capability-era question and belongs to Doctor Frankenstein (monsters/FRANK-000), not to a descendant of Hephaestus.

design_vs_hypothesis.finding: The certification design compared candidate tools against an NCD baseline without first publishing P(random tool passes). On the 15-trap battery that baseline scores below chance (0.267 acc / 0.133 cal), so the gate could not test the hypothesis it was built to test until the 186-trap battery replaced it on 2026-03-27.

code_vs_design.finding: forge_one returns status=scrap / reason=api_call_failed after per-item retries and the caller writes every non-forged result as scrap; the daemon skip set is set(ledger.keys()). Net effect: 2,861 combos buried on first API failure, 0 retried. The design said retry-with-backoff; the code retried the item and then buried the key.

execution_parameters.finding: Instrument state (api_call_failed / wall_clock_timeout / test_harness_error) was recorded in the outcome column: 2,553 of ~4,700 post-03-27 rows. Yield changes by <1pp per honest era when they are removed, so this did not cause the death, but it made the ledger unusable as a label set and misled the Coeus scorer downstream.

hallucination_scan.finding: The 06-24 dossier figure (~1,960 tools were ~5 genuine mechanisms) lives inside the vacuous certification layer: 353 of ~385 forged certificates before 03-27 are passes of a gate a random tool passes 92.75% of the time. The number is not false, but the certificate it counts was. Aporia's earlier TOOLS-DISCRIMINATE reading rested on an adapter leak (distractors derived from truth+3i) and was retracted by its own v2.

salvageable_data: agents/hephaestus/ledger.jsonl as a failure-mining / kill-geometry dataset (6651 keys with reason strings, accuracy fractions, era-recoverable battery size) -- NOT as a label set for scorers (see coeus.dossier.json)
agents/nemesis/adversarial/adversarial_results.jsonl (92 prompts x 140 tools; usable only with the position payload controlled)
salvageable_schemas: ledger row shape, with two required additions: an instrument_state field separate from status, and battery_version + priority_source fields
salvageable_operators: per-item retry with backoff (correct in isolation; wrong when combined with a permanent skip set)
salvageable_tests: gate replica in heph_battery_floor.py: any pass gate must publish P(random tool passes) before certifying anything
representation_hints: Never write an instrument-state failure into the same status column as a scientific outcome; the skip set must key on outcome rows only.
A relative pass gate ('beat baseline X') is only meaningful if X is above the chance floor; publish the floor and the random-pass rate with every battery version.
Position-balance every multiple-choice battery (correct index uniform) or a constant-index tool will read as skilled.

disposition.rationale: TRUE_CORPSE because the premise -- LLM-forged tools from this pipeline reason above chance -- was tested at power and failed on three independent instruments: the forge's own honest battery (1,803 battery-tested tools, yield <= random pass rate, while hand-written engines pass the same battery), Nemesis (140 tools at chance once the first-or-last payload is controlled), and Aporia (48 tools flat at chance once the adapter leak is removed). Not MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: that class fits Coeus, whose premise never met an adequate instrument; here the March certificates ARE a measurement failure (random passes 93%), but from 03-27 an adequate instrument existed, was applied ~1,803 times, and the population sat at its floor. Not RESOURCE_BLOCKED: 2,861 combos were buried by API death, but the kill does not depend on them -- excluding instrument rows moves yield by <1pp in every honest era. Not SUPERSEDED_BUT_ORGANS_SALVAGEABLE: organs ARE salvageable (residue lists them) but no successor took over the forge's function -- the thing that replaced its output was hand-written engines built from its failures, i.e. a different premise, and this class would misreport the premise as merely displaced rather than falsified. Not PREMISE_ALIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_DEAD: the implementation ran 6,651 attempts as designed; the premise is what did not survive. Not ORCHESTRATION_FAILURE: the skip-set burial is real and is recorded as a failure class, but it is a defect on top of a corpse, not the cause of death. The 2026-06 advisory REVIVE is overturned; the 06-24 dossier's own summary ('falsified by its own instrumentation') was right, its disposition was not.

provenance.investigator: Mnemosyne (Keeper of the Necropolis), Necromancer fork
unresolved_questions: Would a frontier model + honest gate + position-balanced battery forge above chance? Not a Hephaestus fact; a NEW premise. It would cost live LLM calls (~1,000 attempts under one frozen battery) and is the only route to a descendant. Not proposed here because nothing in the corpse predicts the answer.
Where are the ~1,600 forged tools the 06-24 dossier counted but the repo does not hold (F:/ inventory)?

Which of the 5 W3 revival-era forged tools (6.8% among battery-tested) survive a payload-free re-measurement? Small n; a Cleric could run them through Aporia's v2 exchangeable-distractor battery without any LLM call.

Coeus hand-off closed: Q1 (api_call_failed as outcome + skip-set burial; yields with instrument rows separated) and Q2 (no priority field, never recoverable; battery version recoverable per row from denominators + commit windows) are answered in observed_history and surviving_claims.
